item.title: Psalm 25: God Guides, Teaches, and Guards Those Who Trust Him
item.description: Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 25 and highlights its central message: God guides, teaches, and guards those who trust Him.

item.title: How Deception Begins: Early Warning Signs Every Christian Should Recognize
item.description: How does spiritual deception usually begin? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains from Genesis 3 and James 1 how deception starts quietly through neglect of God's Word, unchecked desires, distorted truth, and untested influences.

item.title: Bethel Under Scrutiny: A Biblical Response to Prophetic Teaching and Accountability Concerns
item.description: In this episode of From NAR to Christ, Dawn Hill examines serious concerns regarding leadership accountability and prophetic teaching associated with Bethel Church and the broader New Apostolic Reformation (NAR) movement. Listeners are encouraged to evaluate all claims in light of Scripture and to prioritize Christ's glory above movements or personalities.

item.title: Psalm 133: The Beauty, Sacredness, and Blessing of Biblical Unity

item.title: Testing Everything by Scripture: Biblical Discernment Explained
item.description: Scripture commands believers to test everything and hold fast to what is good (1 Thessalonians 5:21–22). In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how Christians evaluate teaching, claims, and spiritual experiences by the authority of God's Word.
